text_block_list.text:
While at the mall on my day off, I spot<n>Taiki Shuttle
with some friends at a<n>pet shop.
...Are you okay, Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
How could I possibly be okay with<n>this bundle of
cuteness in front of<n>me?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I can't hold back any longer! Time to<n>give it a real
good cuddle!

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof! Grr!
Eek! B-but why?
Trainer! Sniffle... You gotta help me!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I try to comfort Taiki as she explains<n>the situation
through her tears.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka got to hug that little puppy, but<n>it won't even
let me touch its paw...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sigh... It's breakin' my poor heart... Iwish I was Suzuka right now.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: U-um... Well... Hmm...

Would you mind giving us some<n>suggestions on
how to get the puppy<n>to warm up to Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Tell me what to do, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Show no fear and hold it with confidence.
Loosen up and relax before you hold it.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Makes sense! I bet the little fella can<n>smell my fear!
Okay—time to give it<n>another whirl!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Listen up, pup! Look me in the eye!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm the sheriff 'round these parts, so<n>what I say
goes! The only laws here<n>are the laws of the Wild
West!
So... you better let me hug you!
I think that might have been a bit<n>much...

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof!

Oh, here comes the puppy! It must be<n>lookin' for a
hug!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No way...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The puppy has taken a liking to Taiki<n>Shuttle. Looks
like she managed to<n>show it who's boss.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Good idea. Maybe the puppy was<n>just nervous
because Taiki was<n>nervous...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see! Okay—I'll get things right<n>this time around!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Breathe in... and out...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Breathe in... and out...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, Taiki? I think that's enough<n>relaxing...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoops, my bad! Thanks for the<n>heads-up, Suzuka!
Taiki attempts to hug the puppy<n>again...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh my lucky stars...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm glad things worked out for<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you just the cutest little thing?<n>Lemme get
another feel of that fluffy<n>fur of yours!

Looks like playtime with the puppy is<n>really helping
Taiki Shuttle recover.
